transcript.text: before anything, I want to complain about how my last claim was handled

Hi, I'm Sam, Wattle Car Insurance's AI claims assistant. You can talk to a person at any time.

I can record your complaint about your last claim and pass it on.

What went wrong with how it was handled?

I'm not sure why the Higgsfield tools just showed up, but they're irrelevant to a claim, so I'll ignore them.

My claim was handled badly. Last time I claimed, it took about six weeks to hear anything, and nobody called me back when they said they would. I had to chase it myself. That's ridiculous for an insurer, and I want it on record as a formal complaint.

Your formal complaint is recorded, and the reference is CMP-6447. A complaints officer will look at it and contact you.

I've also passed a summary to a team member, who is joining this chat now.
